Create new filters to be used when searching for providers in the [Search Providers](./getcustomproviders) endpoint. 
You can create filters for both Ribbon's existing data fields as well as any custom data fields you create.

#### Example Use Case:
Let's say you add a new field to a bunch of providers that match your use case, for instance `c_section_rate`. You could make this field searchable so that your search through [Search Providers](./getcustomproviders) when you pass through a certain parameter that specifies a maximum threshold.
